info.title: Simple Pet Store API (mock)
info.description: A tiny mock API for demonstrating ADK's OpenAPIToolset. Backed by postman-echo.com, which just echoes back whatever it receives — so every call is real over the wire, but nothing has real pet-store behaviour behind it. Zero auth, zero setup, so it works the same on every machine.

get.summary: List pets, optionally filtered by status

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of pets to return

200.description: A list of pets (echoed request — postman-echo has no real pet data)
The created pet (echoed back by postman-echo)
